combo_label: The Human Body × Whisky & Distilling × Lighthouses

entries.clue: Compressed bog moss, dug and dried, whose smoke perfumes island whiskies
Twilight star who plays Ephraim Winslow, the newcomer slowly unravelling on the rock
Tissue that contracts to move the bones.
Warm ticklish hollow where the upper limb meets the body.
Illicit spirit run off by night, and a word for utter nonsense
Its Butt, a windswept northern tip, carries an unpainted red-brick light
What the wood lends a dram, to grip and pucker the tongue
Digit stubbed on furniture in the dark.
Largest of the Inner Hebrides, and Talisker's home ground
Hinge joint capped by a small floating bone.
Wailing signal that takes over from the light when the air turns to soup
Deliverance that oars, ropes and raw courage bring to a stranded crew
